$comment: Written by scripts/eehrxf/validate.py; do not edit. build.py reads it.

validator.terminology: not checked: run with -tx n/a, so codes are checked for shape, not against SNOMED CT, LOINC or the IG value sets
validator.passRule: a resource passes when the validator reports no error or fatal issue

ignoredIssues.contains: conditional references are only valid inside a transaction Bundle
ignoredIssues.reason: Synthea writes conditional references to practitioners and organisations inside its transaction Bundle. The sample lifts resources out of that Bundle, so the rule cannot hold there; scripts/load_fhir_neo4j.py reads them inside it.

documents.description: FHIR documents the hub builds from the graph: Patient Summaries and laboratory reports of seeded patients

facade.description: Resources the neo4j-proxy FHIR facade serves, mapped from fixed graph rows

klarbefund.description: Golden bundles of the shared FHIR writer (Klarbefund iPhone app and services/epa-ingest)

reference.description: Reference examples with fictional data for profiles the hub produces nothing for; validated, never counted

synthea.description: Seeded Synthea sample, cut to the resource types scripts/load_fhir_neo4j.py loads
